event_text: Outages begin; an internal email says USDA uncovered a security incident and is resetting all database passwords
notes: Dates per the email Nextgov saw and DTN's employee reports.

event_text: NBC says USDA tells employees that a system was targeted
notes: Per NBC's sources; the notice may be a later one than Monday's email.

event_text: Nextgov publishes the first report of the security incident
DTN reports outages and quotes a USDA under secretary calling it a cyberthreat
notes: Original post time, 5:41 PM Central. Updated Friday with more of his remarks.

event_text: DTN updates its report with the under secretary's comments that no personal information was involved
NBC News reports that hackers accessed the farmer-payment system, citing sources
Reuters relays the NBC report; CISA refers questions to USDA
GAO releases a report finding gaps in USDA and FDA work on food-sector cybersecurity; it does not mention this incident
